statement:
∀ (κ t : ℝ),
  0 < κ → 0 < t → ∀ (k : ℝ), ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑(heatKernel κ t x) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑x) * I) = cexp (-(↑κ * ↑k ^ 2 * ↑t))

goal.text: ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑(heatKernel κ t x) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑x) * I) = cexp (-(↑κ * ↑k ^ 2 * ↑t))
goal.lhs: ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑(heatKernel κ t x) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑x) * I)

atoms: ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑(heatKernel κ t x) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑x) * I)
